title: SEAT ASM & INSTALLATION
summary: Bucket seat installation (all models): each seat sits on a pair of seat adjuster tracks (seat tracks/runners) that bolt to the floor pan. Screws go down through the track feet into the floor, a screw assembly is driven up from below at the front of the track, and a bracket on the seat cushion side is held by a screw and washer. The adjuster release lever carries a threaded knob.

fastening.note: Screws [1] go down from above through the feet of the adjuster track [6] into the floor (two shown, on the right-hand track: front inboard foot and rear foot).
Screw assembly [2] is shown driven upward from below the floor into the front of the adjuster track [6], next to screw [1].
Screw [4] with washer [3] goes up into the lower tab of bracket [7] at the outboard side of the seat cushion, above the adjuster [6]; bracket [7] lines up with two holes in the cushion frame.
Knob [5] threads onto the end of the adjuster [6] release lever (the lever has its own threaded end; no separate fastener).
Dashed lines show the seat cushion frame tabs dropping onto the tops of the adjusters [6]; no fastener is called out for that joint.

notes_internal: Screw asm [2]: the drawing shows it from below pointing up, but it is not clear whether it passes through the floor pan or only the adjuster; described as 'from below'.
